name: List items
purpose: Lists display a series of related points together in a structured, easily readable way. Covers the tappable list-row family (Account, Badge, Item, Review, Review Detail, Transaction) plus typeset bullet/ordered/custom lists. Interactive rows share the state set default / hover (web) / pressed / disabled / processing and a visual option of icon / avatar / image.
$family: Covers the 'List items' canvas (page title 'Lists'); each row type is a separate Figma component.

props.name: state
props.$note: hover labelled 'hover (web)'. Bullets list has no interactive state.

props.name: visual
props.$note: Badge, Item, Transaction offer a leading visual.

variants.name: account
variants.use: Account row (e.g. balance), font-3 amount + font-5/6 labels. MIGRATED to tertiary/background/* row states.

variants.name: badge
variants.use: Row with a leading badge/visual. Least-migrated row — still on deprecated surface/border tokens.

variants.name: item
variants.use: Base list item (icon/avatar/image). Most-deprecated row, incl on-dark surface/border blockers.

variants.name: review
variants.use: Compact review row. Mostly migrated (tertiary/background/*); one deprecated pressed surface.

variants.name: review-detail
variants.use: Review row with extra detail line. CLEAN.

variants.name: transaction
variants.use: Transaction row with tag or status detail; uses rag/success(+tint) for status. Deprecated surface set.

variants.name: bullets
variants.use: Typeset unordered / ordered / custom lists. CLEAN. Bullets/numbers use the SAME font as the text; rag/success for custom tick.

tokens.row-surface (LIVE): tertiary/background/default #ffffff, hover #f3f3f3, pressed #767676, disabled #ffffff (Account, Review, Review Detail)
tokens.row-surface (DEPRECATED, value-identical: interactive (depricate)/on-light/surface/primary/default|hover|pressed|disabled — same #fff/#f3f3f3/#767676/#fff → rebind to tertiary/background/* (Item, Badge, Transaction)
tokens.text: text/default #333333 @ font-5 medium (title) / font-5 light (supporting); font-3 medium (account amount); font-6/7; text/reverse on pressed; text/disabled #d7d8d6
tokens.bullets: text/default; bullets/numbers use same font as text; custom tick rag/success; grey-1 #f3f3f3 (primitive)

accessibility.semantics: Typeset lists must use real <ul>/<ol>/<li> semantics (1.3.1); interactive rows expose role/label and state (disabled, processing)
accessibility.states: default/hover(web)/pressed/disabled/processing must each be perceivable; pressed flips to dark surface + reverse text — ensure contrast holds
accessibility.processing: REVIEW (inferred): processing state should announce status (aria-live/aria-busy)
accessibility.bulletsCopy: Lead-in sentence ends with a colon; if items complete it, don't capitalise the first letter and use no end punctuation; ordered lists must never complete a lead-in sentence

antiPatterns: Using decorative shapes or alternative colours for bullets/numbers — use the same font/colour as the text
Letting an ordered list complete a lead-in sentence
Capitalising / adding end punctuation to items that complete a lead-in sentence
Leaving rows bound to the deprecated surface/primary + non-interactive neutral tokens — migrate to tertiary/background/* (see tokenValidation)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.result: PASS — bullets/Account/Review Detail clean; Review near-clean; Item/Badge/Transaction carry deprecated tokens. KEY: two row-surface conventions exist (live tertiary/background/* vs deprecated interactive/surface/primary/*) with value-identical colours = clean migration path.
tokenValidation.primitiveBinding: List Badge binds primitive color/primary (#db0011) directly + bullets bind colour/neutral/grey-1 primitive — same primitive-leak flag as Badge/Hero/Links.

cleanRebinds.rebind: text/default (#333333 — value change, confirm; same flag as Button/Cards)

blockersNoEquivalent.rebind: REVIEW — no live subtle-surface (Avatar/Headers gap family)
REVIEW — no live on-dark surface (Avatar/Hero gap)
REVIEW — no live (Avatar on-dark border blocker)

depricateUsage.perType: account=clean; review-detail=clean; bullets=clean; review=1 (pressed surface, clean); badge≈7; item≈12 (incl on-dark blockers); transaction≈8.
